Here’s what to know about moving your Spring store to Amaze Commerce.

Amaze offered complimentary store migration to a limited group of eligible Spring creators. If you received and accepted this invitation, the migration details in your email apply to you. The FAQs below describe the standard transition process for all other creators.
What’s the timeline for the Spring shutdown?

Spring is shutting down in stages. Spring stores and selling tools will be turned off on October 28, 2026, and the Creator Dashboard is currently scheduled to close on November 5, 2026. We’ll communicate any changes to these dates by email and on this page.
New product creation is off
You can no longer create new products on Spring. Your existing store and listings will remain live until October 28. To create and launch new products, head to Amaze Commerce.
October 28, 2026 — Spring stores and selling tools shut down
On October 28, Spring stores will stop receiving traffic and accepting new orders. Storefront management and listing tools will also be disabled.
• Provide required tax information

If you purchased a custom domain through Spring, domain renewals will continue until October 28. A self-service domain transfer tool will become available when renewals end, allowing you to transfer your domain to another registrar.
Why can't I launch new products on Spring?
Spring is being retired, so new product creation has been turned off as the first phase of the shutdown. Your existing store and listings stay live, and you can keep managing them for now.
Will all of my products move over?
No. Your Spring products will not automatically transfer to Amaze Commerce. If you'd like to continue selling your products, you'll need to recreate them in your new Amaze Commerce store.
We recommend downloading any artwork, product images, and listing details you want to keep before Spring's selling tools shut down on October 28, 2026.
Yes. You'll need to create an Amaze Commerce account, set up your new storefront, and recreate any Spring products you want to continue selling.
